column1: # Companion move list: PROPOSAL ONLY. Nothing reads this to move or delete a file (T-1674, source: T-1599 sections 2, 4).
#   path   a tracked path. A trailing "/" is a directory prefix, a trailing "*" a name prefix, anything else one exact file.
#          The LONGEST matching path wins, so a file entry overrides its directory.
#   class  source    stays in the public repo (T-1599 4.1)
#          companion goes to the private companion repo at the same path (T-1599 4.2, 4.3)
#          stays     stays in the tree for now and is not source: waits for an owner decision (T-1599 section 12)
#          drop      goes nowhere: neither public source nor copied to the companion
# Every tracked path must match a row; scripts/companion/dry_run.sh fails on one that does not.
